assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE sparse transparent mid-depth parallax overlay for an existing 2D fighting game Venice canal stage, 1600 x 900 landscape. Input image is strict camera, paint style, material and lighting reference ONLY. Do not reproduce the opaque scene. Add only small edge framing details that complement the current buildings and canal: at the extreme LEFT edge a cropped narrow old wrought-iron lantern bracket attached to an unseen wall, with one small unlit weathered lantern near x=70 y=280, thin trailing dry ivy and a very narrow chipped ochre stone edge; at the extreme RIGHT edge a slim weathered mooring timber and one slack rope loop. Keep all visible geometry STRICTLY in x=0..140 or x=1460..1600. The right timber ends around source y=790, matching the quay level. Match the source's overcast golden late-day atmosphere, aged ochre plaster, muted olive-black iron and subtle moss. Same straight-on side-view, realistic painted game environment. Entire x=160..1440 is fully transparent top to bottom; no objects, fog or gradients there. No additional buildings, bridges, boats, full columns, floor plane, water plane, characters, text, UI, signs or background. Preserve genuine alpha transparency and clean isolated edges. Output one overlay, not a collage or object sheet.

visual_review.observations: Sparse lateral accents and low corner debris preserve the central duel area. No opaque panorama, large duplicated scene structure, character, text or UI.
